narration.welcome: I'm Doctor Rho. Before we start, I want to put you where you actually belong — not so far back that you're bored, not so far ahead that you're lost.
narration.intake: Tell me in your own words what you already know about this. Write whatever comes to mind; there's no wrong answer.
narration.quiz: A few short questions now. If you don't know one, say so — that helps me just as much.
narration.confirm: One more to confirm, and we're done.
narration.resultAhead: Look at that! You already knew a good chunk, so we're skipping what you've got covered.
narration.resultStart: We'll start from the beginning. It's the best place to build solid foundations.
narration.adjust: I'm Zara. If this feels too far ahead, move it back — no shame in it. You decide where to start.

welcome.title: Let's find your starting point
welcome.subtitle: Just a few short questions. Nobody repeats what they know, and nobody starts where they're lost.
